title: Web Hosting Plans Credit on Maximum-Term Extensions — Domain Registrations
content:
For Domain Registrations domains that are the primary domain of a Web Hosting Plans plan, a maximum-term extension carries the maximum-term hosting credit, one of the maximum-term credits.

### Benefit terms

The maximum-term hosting credit is USD 3.00 for each maximum-term year where a Harborline hosting plan (Web Hosting Plans) whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each maximum-term year where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

### Questions this benefit answers

**Does a plan in a status other than active earn the credit?** No. Only a plan whose status is active counts.

**Does a plan for a different primary domain help this domain?** No. The plan must have this domain as its primary domain.

**Is a billing term of exactly 12 months the higher rate?** Yes: 12 months or more earns USD 3.00 for each maximum-term year; a 1-month term earns USD 1.50 for each maximum-term year.

**Is the credit counted per year or per order?** Per maximum-term year. Hypothetically, an extension of 6 maximum-term years for a domain whose plan is active on a 1-month term earns six times USD 1.50, that is USD 9.00; with the plan active on a 12-month term it earns USD 18.00.
